name: btn-hover-top-slowflip
blurb: Skewed background scales and flips into view on hover.
description: A button where the text flips up on hover while a skewed background layer scales into view behind it, creating a 3D flip effect.
use_when: A premium CTA with a 3D, interactive feel.
avoid_when: Minimal designs or when the motion might feel excessive.
a11y: Native button element with keyboard support.
